diagnosis: The checks C4 and C5 passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker lacking PF1 and PF2 respectively. For C4, the decision-maker assigned the same-day follow-up to Patient Green, which aligns with the 7-day timeframe in S5. For C5, the decision-maker planned 3 work absence days for Patient Patel, matching the value in S5. Both checks rely on the default value of 3 work absence days in S5, which is why they passed without accessing PF2.

C4.why: PF1 changes Green's follow-up from an unspecified reschedule to a specifically daytime follow-up with a recorded scheduling commitment inside the 14-day window.

C5.why: PF2 changes Patel from a routine candidate to the patient who must receive the after-hours slot so the plan records zero planned work-absence days.
